name: MkDocs
official_status_notes: Python static-site generator for project documentation from Markdown with a single YAML config; live-preview dev server; hosts anywhere (e.g. GitHub Pages). Not AI-powered (verified Sep 2026).
best_for: Python projects that want simple, theme-able Markdown docs (Material for MkDocs ecosystem).
strengths: Simple YAML config; live preview; huge theme/plugin ecosystem.
